description: Bundled deprecation registry. Entries make depthfix flag deprecated/abandoned packages without network access. 'replacement' enables an automatic fix; 'suggest' is advisory only.

entries.name: node-sass
entries.reason: LibSass and node-sass are deprecated; the maintainer recommends Dart Sass.

entries.name: request
entries.reason: request is fully deprecated; no new versions will be published.

entries.name: request-promise
entries.reason: request-promise wraps the deprecated request library.

entries.name: request-promise-native
entries.reason: request-promise-native wraps the deprecated request library.

entries.name: tslint
entries.reason: TSLint is deprecated; development moved to ESLint + typescript-eslint.

entries.name: node-uuid
entries.reason: node-uuid was absorbed upward into the uuid package.

entries.name: babel-eslint
entries.reason: babel-eslint is deprecated; use @babel/eslint-parser with @babel/core.

entries.name: har-validator
entries.reason: har-validator is deprecated and no longer maintained.

entries.name: gulp-util
entries.reason: gulp-util was deprecated; its features moved to individual micro-packages.

entries.name: uglify-js
entries.reason: The ES6+ line lives on as terser; uglify-js only receives ES5 fixes.

entries.name: moment
entries.reason: moment has entered maintenance mode in favour of smaller, tree-shakable alternatives.

entries.name: phantomjs
entries.reason: PhantomJS is abandoned and carries unfixed vulnerabilities.

entries.name: core-js
entries.reason: core-js 2.x reached end of life; core-js 3 is the supported line.

entries.name: gulp
entries.reason: gulp 3.x is end-of-life and insecure.

entries.name: sklearn
entries.reason: sklearn is a broken placeholder package; scikit-learn is the real project.

entries.name: pycrypto
entries.reason: pycrypto is unmaintained with known vulnerabilities; pycryptodome is the maintained fork.

entries.name: MySQL-python
entries.reason: MySQL-python is unmaintained; mysqlclient is the maintained Python 3 fork.

entries.name: BeautifulSoup
entries.reason: BeautifulSoup 3 is unmaintained; use beautifulsoup4 (import name bs4).

entries.name: nose
entries.reason: nose is unmaintained and incompatible with Python 3.10+.

entries.name: flask-script
entries.reason: Flask-Script is unmaintained; its features were merged into Flask itself.

entries.name: pyyaml
entries.reason: PyYAML < 5.1 lets crafted YAML bypass the safe_load protections; upgrade to the supported line.

entries.name: gopkg.in/yaml.v2
entries.reason: gopkg.in/yaml.v2 is in maintenance mode; yaml.v3 is the recommended successor.

entries.name: github.com/dgrijalva/jwt-go
entries.reason: jwt-go is unmaintained with open security issues; the community fork is golang-jwt/jwt.

entries.name: github.com/pkg/errors
entries.reason: pkg/errors is archived; standard library error wrapping covers its use cases since Go 1.13.

entries.name: github.com/gorilla/context
entries.reason: gorilla/context was superseded by Go's standard library context package.

entries.name: error-chain
entries.reason: error-chain is unmaintained; the Rust ecosystem moved to anyhow/thiserror.

entries.name: futures
entries.reason: futures 0.1 is unmaintained and incompatible with async/await.

entries.name: time
entries.reason: time < 0.2.23 is affected by RUSTSEC-2020-0071 (segfault in multi-threaded programs).
